verdict.rationale: The docs show files can be sent into a Bot chat via the iPhone share sheet (docs-21), and Bots keep files across sessions on a cloud computer with a filesystem (docs-5, docs-1). The files-and-results page lists CSV, JSON, YAML, source code and Jupyter notebooks (docs-28), which covers structured-data and spreadsheet-like files. Missing for 10: explicit PDF and office-document (DOCX/XLSX) support, a documented desktop upload flow, evidence of the analysis capability itself and its accuracy, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
